attempts.sql: WITH base AS (SELECT s.symbol_id FROM code.symbols s JOIN code.files f ON f.file_id = s.file_id WHERE f.module = 'auto_ontology/retrieval/text_to_sql/base' AND s.name = 'BaseAgent' AND s.kind = 'class'), agents AS (SELECT s.symbol_id, s.name FROM code.symbols s JOIN code.files f ON f.file_id = s.file_id JOIN code.class_bases cb ON cb.class_symbol_id = s.symbol_id WHERE s.kind = 'class' AND NOT f.is_test AND cb.base_name = 'BaseAgent' AND (cb.base_symbol_id IN (SELECT symbol_id FROM base) OR cb.base_symbol_id IS NULL)), non_test_calls AS (SELECT DISTINCT c.callee_name FROM code.calls c JOIN code.symbols caller ON caller.symbol_id = c.caller_symbol_id JOIN code.files cf ON cf.file_id = caller.file_id WHERE NOT cf.is_test AND c.call_kind = 'constructor'), test_calls AS (SELECT DISTINCT c.callee_name FROM code.calls c JOIN code.symbols caller ON caller.symbol_id = c.caller_symbol_id JOIN code.files cf ON cf.file_id = caller.file_id WHERE cf.is_test AND c.call_kind = 'constructor') SELECT a.symbol_id AS class_symbol_id FROM agents a WHERE a.name IN (SELECT callee_name FROM non_test_calls) AND a.name NOT IN (SELECT callee_name FROM test_calls) ORDER BY a.symbol_id

request:
Consider the agent classes defined in non-test code that directly subclass BaseAgent from auto_ontology/retrieval/text_to_sql/base.py (every file under a tests/ folder, conftest.py and helpers included, is test code). Which of these agent classes are constructed (the class is called by name, e.g. ResponseAgent()) somewhere in non-test code but are never constructed anywhere in test code? Count only direct constructor calls written in a function or method body; patching or referencing a class without calling it does not count, and a test that calls a function which constructs the class does not count as constructing it. Return their class symbol IDs.

Requested output columns: class_symbol_id (string).
explanation: Finds BaseAgent's symbol in base.py, then selects non-test classes whose base is BaseAgent. It checks which of those class names appear as constructor calls in non-test code but not in test code, returning their symbol IDs.
